notes.title: Boss Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991812/a233278de87458f831e3b18d891a7559d6f3459b.png

Bosses updated and nerfed with some settings menu options added.

These changes will hopefully create are far more fair, balanced and streamline experience without halting or slowing down progression through the game. 

All bosses have been made easier. 

 Minor bosses (Arena 7,14,20,26) have had their health slightly reduced. This is to create a more straight forward experience that doesn't roadblock or slow down progression through the arenas. All gold completion times have also been slightly lowered.
 Major Bosses (Arena 10,17,23) have multiple changes to help, Including the ability to heal while fighting them.


Major boss changes


 Arena 10 boss 

 Added regular enemies in the level to give the player an opportunity to regain health by killing them. 

 Arena 17 boss 
 
 The bosses melee attack wont push back the player until after the boss first takes damage. (won't push back at all in easy mode)
 The ground Stomp 'shock-wave' expands slower
 Time between each ground stomp is increased (increased even more in easy mode).
 Time between firing projectiles increased (increased even more in easy mode).
 Enemy projectiles move slightly slower
 Slightly fewer electrified puddles on the ground
 Damaging the boss now heals the player
 Time it takes to electrify each tower is significantly increased
 Health segments reduced by 1
 Collision surfaces updated and being stuck under the tower should now be near impossible

 Arena 23 boss 

 Ground will now glow red before and while casting damaging abilities
 Player health will be returned to full at the begging of the 2nd phase
 Increased time delay between Casting new abilities
 Fire attack takes longer to begin
 Explosion attack takes longer to explode after spawning
 Reduces the total number of spawned explosion attacks that happen at once
 Time before the boss electrifies himself is increased
 Health segments reduced by 1 (affects both phases)
 Checkpoint at the beginning of the 2nd phase added
 Golden completion time decreased by 1 minute
 Boss should now be much easier to hit during phase 1



Settings added
 
 Option to decrease mouse sensitivity while sprinting
 Option to decrease mouse sensitivity while aiming with ranged weapons
 Difficulty change option added to the pause screen which allows you to change the difficulty in game without going back to the main menu


Also minor bug fixes and spelling errors fixed.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991812/3d22b81fecc8502fe2c1929bc24b2e9a69960b04.jpg

Update#1

Added Easy Difficultly setting for arena levels. 

- Easy mode changes -

 Damage received is reduced
 Fewer enemies will engage the player at the same time
 Lower fire rate of ranged enemies
 Ranged enemies are less accurate
 All bosses on easy mode are made easier with unique adjustments. 
 XP gained from easy difficulty is slightly less than from normal difficulty


 Boss nerfs 

[olist]
 (Arena 7) 

 Reduced melee damage
 Change melee attack animation (removing double punch for a single punch).
 Reduced health

  (Arena 10) 

 Laser temporarily turns off after taking damage 
 Laser damage reduced
 Hit detection not so punishing

  (Arena 14) 

 Slower attacks
 Lower recovery time after being hit
 Reduced health
 Reduced damage dealt

  (Arena 17) 

 The laser that targets the grapple towers will not also hit the player

  (Arena 20) 

 Slower attacks
 Reduced health
 Reduced damage dealt

  (Arena 26) 

 Ability timings increased
 Reduced damage dealt
 Lower recovery time after being hit

[/olist]
Grapple Improvements. 

Grapple surface hit detection increased and should now be much easier to to initiate a grapple swing from.

Other changes. 


 Various audio fixes 
 Boss duplication bug fixes
 Misspelled words fixed
 Power-ups description text now fits inside container better
